answer_text:
Here are reliable places to order an Eid beauty gift across the GCC (UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). I’m listing options that typically offer gift sets, fast delivery, and GCC-wide or country-wide coverage.

## GCC-wide / multi-country options
- **Sephora Middle East** (UAE/KSA/Kuwait/Qatar/Bahrain/Oman)  
  Eid edits, fragrance/beauty gift sets, gift wrapping in some markets.  
  Website: https://www.sephora.ae (country switcher available)

- **Faces / WOW Beauty** (strong GCC presence; availability varies by country)  
  Often has Eid bundles and discounted sets.  
  Website: https://www.faces.com (may redirect by country)

- **Ounass** (UAE & wider GCC delivery for many items)  
  Luxury beauty + fragrance gifts; premium packaging.  
  Website: https://www.ounass.ae

- **Amazon** (Amazon.ae / Amazon.sa)  
  Huge selection of gift sets; look for “Fulfilled by Amazon” for faster delivery.

## Great “gift-ready” fragrance options (popular for Eid)
- **Swiss Arabian** (widely available across GCC; strong gifting)  
  https://swissarabian.com (or local retailers)
- **Ajmal Perfumes**  
  https://www.ajmal.com
- **Abdul Samad Al Qurashi (ASQ)**  
  https://asqgrp.com (availability by country)

## Country-specific quick picks
### UAE
- **Sephora UAE** – https://www.sephora.ae  
- **Ounass** – https://www.ounass.ae  
- **NOON UAE** (beauty + fragrance sets; fast shipping) – https://www.noon.com/uae-en/

### Saudi Arabia (KSA)
- **Sephora KSA** – https://www.sephora.sa  
- **Nice One** (very popular for beauty & perfumes) – https://niceonesa.com  
- **NOON KSA** – https://www.noon.com/saudi-en/

### Kuwait / Qatar / Bahrain / Oman
- **Sephora** (local country sites via sephora.ae switcher)  
- **Faces** (where available)  
- **Local department stores / pharmacy chains** (often have curated gift sets)

## If you tell me 3 details, I’ll recommend the best 3 options with direct links
1) Which GCC country are you sending to?  
2) Budget (e.g., under 150 SAR/AED, 150–300, 300+)?  
3) Gift type: skincare, makeup, fragrance, or “mix set”?
